tools.name: betternow_get_organisation
tools.description: Get one charity (organisation) by id: name, description, and links to its projects, fundraisers and donations. GET /organisations/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_list_organisation_projects
tools.description: List the projects (campaigns) of one organisation. Paginated: 50 per range. GET /organisations/{id}/projects.

tools.name: betternow_list_organisation_fundraisers
tools.description: List the fundraising pages of one organisation. Paginated: 50 per range. GET /organisations/{id}/fundraisers.

tools.name: betternow_list_organisation_donations
tools.description: List the donations received by one organisation (public donation fields, no donor details). Paginated. GET /organisations/{id}/donations.

tools.name: betternow_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id: name, description, state, and links to its fundraisers and donations. GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_list_project_fundraisers
tools.description: List the fundraising pages that support one project. Paginated. GET /projects/{id}/fundraisers.

tools.name: betternow_list_events
tools.description: List the events (for example sports events) that use BetterNow fundraising. Paginated. GET /events.

tools.name: betternow_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id: name, dates, location, and links to its projects, fundraisers and teams. GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_list_sites
tools.description: List the BetterNow and branded sites (hostname, subdomain, custom domain) of the anchor. Paginated. GET /sites.

tools.name: betternow_list_fundraisers
tools.description: List the fundraising pages visible to the anchor (name, goal, state, owner links). Paginated: 50 per range. GET /fundraisers.

tools.name: betternow_get_fundraiser
tools.description: Get one fundraising page by id or slug: goal, end date, state, owner, team and project links. GET /fundraisers/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_list_fundraiser_donations
tools.description: List the donations made to one fundraising page (amount, comment, date; no donor details). Paginated. GET /fundraisers/{id}/donations.

tools.name: betternow_list_fundraiser_updates
tools.description: List the progress updates posted on one fundraising page. Paginated. GET /fundraisers/{id}/updates.

tools.name: betternow_get_donation
tools.description: Get one donation by id: amount, comment, date, and the fundraiser, team, project and event it went to. Public fields only. GET /donations/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_get_donation_details
tools.description: Get the PRIVATE details of one donation (donor name, address, tax id, payment). Needs the donation_details:read scope. Use the id from the donation's private_details_url. GET /donation-details/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_get_person
tools.description: Get one person (donor or fundraiser) by id: name, email, phone, consent and links to their donations, fundraisers and teams. Needs people:read. GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_list_person_donations
tools.description: List the donations made by one person. Needs people:read. Paginated. GET /people/{id}/donations.

tools.name: betternow_list_teams
tools.description: List the fundraising teams of the anchor (name, goal, captain, state). Paginated. GET /teams.

tools.name: betternow_get_team
tools.description: Get one team by id: name, goal, captain, state, and links to its fundraisers, donations and projects. GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: betternow_list_team_fundraisers
tools.description: List the fundraising pages that are members of one team. Paginated. GET /teams/{id}/fundraisers.

tools.name: betternow_create_fundraiser
tools.description: CREATES a public fundraising page for a person under a project and site. Needs fundraisers:write. Only call when the user asks for it. POST /fundraisers.

tools.name: betternow_create_team
tools.description: CREATES a public fundraising team under an event and site. Needs teams:write. Only call when the user asks for it. POST /teams.

tools.name: betternow_add_fundraiser_to_team
tools.description: CHANGES a team: adds one fundraising page as a member. Needs team_memberships:write. POST /team-memberships.

tools.name: betternow_remove_fundraiser_from_team
tools.description: CHANGES a team: removes one fundraising page from its team (the page stays). Needs team_memberships:write. DELETE /team-memberships/{fundraiser_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: betternow_list_fundraiser_donations, betternow_get_donation, betternow_get_person · Private data: betternow_get_donation_details · Public sink: betternow_get_person, betternow_create_fundraiser, betternow_create_team, betternow_add_fundraiser_to_team · Destructive: betternow_remove_fundraiser_from_team.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: betternow_list_fundraiser_donations, betternow_get_donation, betternow_get_person · Private data: betternow_get_donation_details · Public sink: betternow_get_person, betternow_create_fundraiser, betternow_create_team, betternow_add_fundraiser_to_team · Destructive: betternow_remove_fundraiser_from_team

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
